reasons.C: Short declaratives and fragments with the passage's flat, no-contraction plainness, and it ends on a quiet concrete moment rather than a moral, as the author does.
reasons.B: Right clipped rhythm and plain diction, but it leans into summarising and neat payoffs ('It is a fair trade', 'Nobody else... looks up. I do.'), which the author avoids, and it piles on the fragments a little.
reasons.A: Long, flowing, subordinated sentences with semicolons and abstract reflection; a smooth essayistic register nothing like the author's terse, concrete notation.
